messages:
olivia: dropping a short RN + rollout plan for v2.3.1-quant. need quick copycheck and someone to own the model pin + canary deploy. plan below.

olivia: RN draft:
• What: v2.3.1 quant profile (lower memory footprint, ~25% throughput uplift in tail workloads)
• Why: reduces token cost while keeping quality parity on long-context prompts
• Fixes: faster KV priming and a bug mitigation for rare streaming stalls
• Compatibility: dedicated customers will get a transparent fallback to v2.3.0 if resources constrained

olivia: rollout plan (tentative): canary 3% -> 30% after 20m -> 100% after 70m. rollback gates: error rate >200% of baseline for 5m OR p95 latency >500ms for 15m. will keep logs at debug for first 30m post-promote.

matt: timeline works for me. i can own the model pin and kickoff. which model id are we pinning?

jordan: i'll own the watch and rollback decision. i'll wire up the canary alerts to the oncall and set a short heartbeat. ping me at canary->30% promote.

sarah: copy nit: change "transparent fallback" -> "automatic fallback to v2.3.0 for Dedicated when capacity limited". also add a one-liner for customers to expect a short perf spike during warmup.

olivia: updated RN per sarah. proposed internal snippet: \"FYI: v2.3.1 quant rollout at 09:00 UTC — reduces avg token cost and speeds cache warmup. Ops monitoring; will post status updates.\" thoughts?

matt: fine. model pin: model-redwood/v2.3.1-q2, stack: inference-v2.3. agree to that id.

matt: deploy-bot run will look like below. i'll schedule at 2025-06-11T09:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @matt. job id: db-1794440001. params: 
```
deploy-bot run db-1794440001 --stage canary --percent 3 --wait 1200 --stagger 30
deploy-bot promote db-1794440001 --percent 30 --wait 4200
deploy-bot promote db-1794440001 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-1794440001 --reason "rollback gate hit"
```

jordan: on the run params — please add --dns-hold 300 after the 30% promote to avoid quick weight flips. i'll also bump alert sensitivity for the first 25m.

sarah: docs will post the internal slack snippet at T-10 and update the release notes page right after 100% promote. suggestion for the one-liner to external customers: \"Rolling update to improve cost and throughput; minor warmup expected.\"

olivia: thanks. i'll post internal snippet in #internal-release at T-10 and ping #customer-ops as well. final checklist: RN updated, model pin set, deploy job scheduled, rollback watch assigned, DNS hold added.

matt: kicking the job to queued at my scheduled time. will report 08:50 UTC if anything changes.

deploy-bot: job db-1794440001 created and moved to queued state by @matt.
